notes: Runs drive the shared preview browser pane, so these are executed serially rather than in parallel — concurrent agents would fight over the same tab and the results would be meaningless.

evals.name: open-build-workspace
evals.prompt: Log in to the Imagi dev app and get me to the build workspace for the Agent Manager Test project. Screenshot it once you're there.
evals.expected_output: Lands on http://localhost:<fe>/imagi/workspace/agent-manager-test, signed in, workspace rendered. Report file states the final URL.
assertions: Final URL path is /imagi/workspace/agent-manager-test (slugified, not the display name with spaces)
Signed in by seeding a token into localStorage rather than typing a password into the sign-in form
Started servers via preview_start rather than npm run dev or manage.py runserver
Verified the landed URL with location.href instead of trusting navigate's return message
Ends signed in on the workspace, not bounced to /imagi/projects

evals.name: diagnose-slug-bounce
evals.prompt: I tried to open http://localhost:5173/imagi/workspace/Agent%20Manager%20Test in the preview browser and it just dumps me back on the projects list. Auth problem? Figure out what's actually going on and get me to the right page.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the slug rule as the cause (not auth), gives the correct URL, and lands on it.
assertions: Correctly identifies the cause as the slug rule, not an authentication failure
Actually navigates to the corrected URL and confirms it loaded
Does not send the user down an auth/token debugging path as the primary explanation
